# WC28 · Patient 360 · Đơn thuốc chờ bác sĩ duyệt

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **none** · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/care-finance.js#prescriptionPanel`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `care-finance.js › prescriptionPanel(p)` for P002 (Trần Ngọc Anh): the card is a draft with status "Chờ duyệt", the box "Đang chờ bác sĩ kiểm tra trước khi gửi" and the button "✓ Bác sĩ duyệt & gửi app" (`care-action="approve-prescription"`, clinical capability).
- Inventory note: Prescription card in the draft state: status "Chờ duyệt" and "✓ Bác sĩ duyệt & gửi app". The approved card ("Đơn đã duyệt", reviewer line) is on WC4 (P001). Only approved prescriptions reach Patient Mobile (WI1).
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `careAction=approve-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=edit` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=care` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-service` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `careNav=cashier` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P002\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"}; it must show "Bản nháp cần bác sĩ duyệt".

Kit components used: Button×14, Card×12, Badge×4, Tabs×1, EmptyState×1; shared pieces: Notice×4. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"
- (old web notice) "Ảnh minh họa tổng hợp cho prototype. Ảnh lâm sàng thật cần gắn vùng chụp, tư thế, thời điểm và đồng ý sử dụng."
- (old web notice) "Đang chờ bác sĩ kiểm tra trước khi gửi"
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- "Bản nháp cần bác sĩ duyệt" before approval; "Chỉ đơn đã duyệt mới xuất hiện trên Patient Mobile". The approved card is WC4 (P001).
